column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
Oh really?! Okay, fine!
What do you mean?!
Shut up! I'm going home!!
Huh? Hey, so are you done with shopping?
This game store was going to be the end!
Oh, I see. Well, that's perfect then.
Grr!! I'm definitely going to make you play this game! Later!
Hey, wait! Kirino!
No matter how much I called out to her, Kirino wouldn't stop. She really left by herself.
Even if I chased after her, she would be in a bad mood. Maybe I should just leave her alone.
*sigh*... I guess I should go home too.
After that, even though we returned home, Kirino and I didn't speak to each other.
Well, there's no helping if she's angry. Either way, she'll be back to normal tomorrow.
But it was really tiring today. We went all over the place.
I shouldn't stay up late and instead get a good rest.
...Kyousuke.
...Huh?
Kyousuke, wake up.
Huh? Ah! Y-Yes!
D-Dad...?
Dad coming into my room first thing in the morning isn't just a bad premonition. It's the worst...!
What is it, Dad...?
I need to talk to you.
W-What is it?!
I heard you forced Kirino to buy these games.
Huh?!
I heard it from mother.  And I heard you even, what was it... you were looking at your own little sister, Kirino, with those kind of eyes.
What kind of eyes?!
It seems Kirino was crying while telling this to Mother. You were trying to lure her in with more than several games filled with your own "interests".
Huh?! W-Wait! It's a misunderstanding! Or rather the opposite!
You said you would take responsibility for keeping these games. They were your, "interests", weren't they?
Y... Yeah...
Very well, come with me. You will give me a proper explanation for the rest of the complaints.
No way! Wait! They were false accusations! False accusations!!!
